source.title: Recent results and open problems on the countability index and the density index of S(X)

trace.notes: Input URL normalized as zbMATH document 4190697. zbMATH web UI returned Cloudflare challenge/403; zbMATH REST API identified Zbl 0722.54040, author K. D. Magill Jr., 1990, source General topology and applications, Lecture Notes in Pure and Applied Mathematics 123, pages 193-202, with no full-text links. Failure mode: metadata_only with blocked_or_challenged resolver UI.

Bounded recovery tried exact-work queries for the full title, title plus PDF/author, and ISBN/proceedings metadata. Rejected Google Books, WorldCat, bookseller, and library catalog pages as metadata or limited preview without the article's problem statements; rejected the Cambridge article 'More On the countability index and the density index of S(X)' because it is a different publication with a different title, venue, pages, and DOI. Crossref and OpenAlex did not return a confirmed readable copy of the exact work.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No extraction was performed because available artifacts were metadata-only, blocked/challenged, limited-preview pages, or different works.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/4190697.json and outputs/latest.json.
